Total memory via --mem-size (default 16GB) split across 4 channels; keep physical memory base 0x80000000.
- Clocks: CPU 2.3GHz, Router/HNF 1.8GHz, DDR controller 600MHz, DDR5-4800 PHY (if the CHIE clock can't be modeled separately, keep 1.8GHz and record the limitation — don't silently ignore).
